plan: A very mobile fox mage who charms her target to take it down in one combo.
aSurveiller: Her E (Charm). It makes you walk towards her without being able to act: stay behind your minions, it stops on the first one hit.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: her charm (E) stops on the first enemy hit.
Engage her once her R is used: her 3 dashes are her only real escape.
Dodge the return of her orb (Q): it deals true damage.
faiblesses: Relies on her R to escape.
Her spells are visible and dodgeable.

sorts.P: Heals after killing minions or champions.
sorts.Q: Orb that goes out and comes back; the return deals true damage.
sorts.E: Kiss that charms the first enemy hit.
sorts.R: Three dashes that shoot nearby enemies.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 6 with her R. Her biggest item spike is Rabadon's Deathcap (3rd or 4th item).
